title: a clean pause menu (and the standard Field of view at +10)
lensAText: a sceptical mobile game UX lead. Look at the builder's before/after frames (the owner's screenshot showed the old eleven-button stack filling a phone screen), then build dist/artifact.html yourself and take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script: pause in Free Drive and in Speed Survival at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3) and 1280x720; tap every control once (Resume, Map and its Go to a freeway, Radio, Phone, Store, Settings and its Feedback, Restart, the exit) and confirm each still works; Esc resumes; keyboard focus is visible. Judge: is it clearly less cluttered and sleek, is nothing lost, does it fit the phone without scrolling, and is the Field of view default +10 for a fresh player and for an untouched old save while a chosen value is kept?
brief: THE OWNER (2026-11-16 ~4:25 PM PT Sun), with a phone screenshot of the in-drive pause menu over the OC Hypercar's seat view (the file was not kept; it shows the eleven stacked buttons listed below filling the screen): "this looks too cluttered, lets fix this and get rid of any unnecessary toggles". Today the pause panel (src/ui/App.tsx, screen === 'paused') is a tall stack of eleven equal buttons: Resume, Phone, Radio, World map, Go to a freeway, Restart, Settings, End drive (Free Drive only), Feedback, Store, Main menu. REDESIGN it to be clean, sleek and quick to use on a phone (390x844) and a laptop, in the game's existing style (the parallelogram buttons, the OC lockup, the glass panel): (1) RESUME as the one big primary action; (2) a compact row (or 2x2 grid) of icon tiles with short labels for the things you do mid-drive: MAP (opens the World Map; fold 'Go to a freeway' into it: the map panel gets a clear 'Go to a freeway' action, so the pause menu loses that button), RADIO, PHONE, STORE; (3) a slim bottom row of small text buttons: SETTINGS, RESTART, and ONE exit button (in Free Drive 'End drive', which shows the drive's result screen whose own 'Main menu' button returns to the menu; in Speed Survival 'Main menu'), so 'End drive' and 'Main menu' are no longer both there; (4) FEEDBACK leaves the pause menu (it is already in Settings next to Done: keep it there); (5) keep the small info lines above (clock/temperature 'sim', the handling chips, the run line) but tighter. Nothing that works today may be lost: every action stays reachable in at most one more tap. Keyboard and gamepad still work (Esc resumes; focus order sensible; visible focus states); accessible names stay meaningful. ALSO in this worktree, UNCOMMITTED, is a small change by the orchestrator to keep and commit with yours: the owner's 'make the standard set pov set at +10': src/game/settings.ts (default fov 10, a fovSet flag: a saved 0 without fovSet reads as +10, a chosen value is kept), src/ui/App.tsx (the slider sets fovSet), tests/regression.mjs (the harness base pins fov 0 + fovSet so older checks keep their view; a new boot check 'the standard Field of view is +10, and a chosen value is kept'). Read 'git diff HEAD' first. TESTS: update the regression checks that click the pause menu's buttons (e.g. 'Main menu', 'Feedback', 'World Map', 'Go to a freeway') to the new layout honestly (never weaken what they assert), and ADD a check: the pause panel shows Resume, the four tiles and the bottom row, no Feedback and no duplicate exit, and it fits a 390x844 phone without scrolling. PROVE: npx tsc --noEmit (both configs); npm run build (one owner-test mark); npm test -- --only=boot,phone,launch (and any other group whose checks you changed; each run under 20 minutes); frames of the pause menu BEFORE (HEAD 7a033fa) and AFTER at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3) and 1280x720, in Free Drive and in Speed Survival, plus the World Map panel showing its new 'Go to a freeway' action, into tests/out/pause/. Do NOT edit src/preview/*, src/onfoot/*, src/game/vehicle/*, Physics.ts or the store's prices. Log it in PROJECT_OC_PROGRESS.md.
